title: Harden DensityGrid gradient domain and finite-output contracts
description: Extend the existing fast-SDF/non-finite gradient owner (TSK-0119) with a small boundary-hardening slice. TryEstimateGradient previously clamped the selected cell index but left trilinear interpolation fractions derived from an out-of-grid point, allowing extrapolation beyond the boundary. It now rejects non-finite points and invalid cell sizes and clamps normalized grid coordinates/fractions to the grid domain. Finite difference outputs are also checked so subtraction/scale overflow cannot leak a non-finite gradient. Preserve existing in-grid behavior. Add regression coverage for out-of-domain points and non-finite points.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: DensityGrid.TryEstimateGradient now finite-checks the query point and CellSize, clamps fx/fy/fz to [0,Cells], clamps u/v/w, and returns false when the resulting gradient is non-finite. EstimateAxis now shares NumericValidity.IsFinite and converts arithmetic overflow to a deterministic zero contribution. Added DensityGridGradientBoundaryTests. No Unity execution was performed in this harness.
